high_value_findings.finding: Persistent room objects introduced soft state, timestamps and placement provenance while only a bounded subset was projected into prompt context.
high_value_findings.transfer: Keep durable memory/state distinct from bounded task/context projection and preserve object provenance/temporal status.

high_value_findings.finding: Genesis was surgically disabled across cognition, topology, UI/API, swarm and systemd/watchdog surfaces while code remained for later reactivation.
high_value_findings.transfer: Subsystem capability gating must deactivate all observable/effect/recovery surfaces coherently; a stopped daemon alone does not remove a subsystem from architecture truth.

high_value_findings.finding: Location could be inferred by IP/timezone and hardcoded fallback; mail persona/language originally mixed into intent and later moved to separate API/system fields; read state moved from client-only to server sync.
high_value_findings.transfer: Track source/uncertainty for inferred personal context; structurally separate user content from persona/control metadata; visible state should reconcile to authoritative persistence.

high_value_findings.finding: Mail UI adopted optimistic bulk/read/delete/spam projections and confirmation dialogs.
high_value_findings.transfer: Optimistic and bulk external effects require explicit receipts, reconciliation and rollback/failure semantics rather than assuming background sync succeeds.

high_value_findings.finding: Papers were rewritten to current Rooms/Qwen/WebUI topology and historical notices removed, while IAPT method/metrics were documented as current claims.
high_value_findings.transfer: Git-history document epochs must be preserved; current paper text cannot replace historical architecture snapshots. Method metrics/novelty require raw-run reconstruction.

high_value_findings.finding: Observability consolidated into Swarm, overlay/writer were deleted in favor of WebUI-only, and multiple models/backends were collapsed to Qwen2.5-3B only.
high_value_findings.transfer: Interface, model and observer topology are explicitly versioned/superseded domains; historical behavior must be interpreted against the active epoch.

negative_results_preserved: IP/timezone-based location detection could end in a hardcoded city fallback.
Genesis had to be fully disabled after being judged unreliable for autonomous improvement on the available model.
Local-only email read state did not survive reload.
Persona/language instructions mixed into user intent leaked into generated email behavior.
Latest papers were rewritten to current topology and historical notices removed.
Large overlay/writer surfaces were deleted after prior development.
The multi-model architecture was later removed and replaced by a single 3B model.
measurement_boundary: IAPT scores/turn counts/training durations, model-storage savings and all other source-reported performance or novelty statements were not independently reproduced.

earned_work.reason: No row-level earned-work overlap audit was performed.

next_falsifiers: Test location-context provenance so IP/timezone/default inference never becomes a durable user fact without evidence/scope.
Capability-disable a subsystem in a staging topology and verify UI/API/watchdog/edges/context all agree it is absent.
Inject mail transport/read-state failures and verify optimistic projections reconcile/rollback against authoritative receipts.
Reconstruct IAPT runs from immutable prompts, evaluator policy, raw transcripts and scoring before retaining quantitative claims.
Query historical architecture by commit epoch and verify latest rewritten papers cannot overwrite prior topology facts.
